_comment: Display-only glosses, 'lemma|pos' (the shipped words.json lemma and pos) -> the en shown to the learner. Merged into words.json en after ranking, example choice and linking (packbuilder core/words.apply_gloss_display), so sentences.json and links never change. Use gloss_overrides.json instead when the gloss should steer examples or links.
引く|verb: to pull; to draw; to subtract; to catch (a cold)
立てる|verb: to set up, to stand (something) up; to make (a plan)
